notes:
Overview: Thistle QueryWorks is an incumbent knowledge platform for a mid-size asset manager with strict UK residency requirements. Evaluating Redwood for a low-latency semantic search + reranking layer to replace an aging OpenSearch cluster.

Key technical constraints:
- Index scale: currently ~8M docs, target >15M within 12 months (mixed short docs + long policies).
- Query volume: 600 qps peak across EU/UK offices, typical 120 qps sustained.
- Latency: target 30-60ms P95 for reranking top-10; absolute max 150ms budget per request.
- Cost: highly cost-sensitive; target <$0.002 per query average across rerank+embed.
- Models: prefer open models (Llama2 variants / Mistral) with 8-bit quant; fallback to hosted LLM for cold queries.
- Routing: multi-region read routing (London primary, Amsterdam secondary) with automatic failover and cold-cache handling.

Recent activity:
- 2025-01-28: Intro call (Ava, Liam, Thistle infra lead Marta) - showed Redwood Dedicated options, asked about VPC/workflow. (ff-20250128-3419).
- 2025-02-10: Security sync; sent Sec FAQ, they returned SOC2 scope questions. Legal flagged "UK residency" explicitly. Action: confirm physical region for data and keys.
- 2025-02-18: POC kickoff — ingest 1M sample docs, baseline embed/rerank perf. (ff-20250218-7842).
- 2025-02-25: First perf anomalies: tail latency spikes at high concurrency when KV cache cold. Logged POC-98.
- 2025-03-02: Demo of canary-aware routing + fallback to smaller model; Thistle asked for cost projection at 10M docs and 600 qps.

PoC scope / acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end ingest to vector index with incremental updates and <3s indexing latency for 1k-doc batches.
- 95th pct response <80ms for typical queries under 120 qps; <150ms under 600 qps.
- Re-ranking quality within 2% of current Elastic tuning on benchmark prompt set.
- Documentation of audit logging and KMS integration for key rotation.

Stakeholder quotes / notes:
- Marta (Infra): "We cannot have customer data leave UK/EU—need hard guarantee and contract language."
- Head of Search (internal): "If you can hit our tail latency and beat cost by 20%, it's a no-brainer."

Open items / Risks:
- Need a written EU/UK residency SLA and KMS/EKMS proof for Private deployment.
- Long documents: need chunking strategy; reranker input token limits may force multi-stage scoring.
- Quantization QA: business concerned about hallucination/regression with 8-bit models on legal text.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to run 600 qps POC in London region using Dedicated pool + VPC peering (SE: Liam).
- Security to provide formal data residency statement and example DPA clause.
- Pricing team to provide a 12-month burn estimate for projected 15M doc index and 600 qps profile.
- Schedule follow-up with legal and infra (target week of 2025-03-17).
